segments.text: Part 1. You will hear a woman phoning a community sports center to ask about swimming courses for adults. First, you have some time to look at questions 1 to 5.
That is the end of Part 1. You now have thirty seconds to check your answers.

part.title: Joining an adult swimming course

turns.text: Good morning, Eastside Community Sports Center. This is Greg speaking. How can I help you?
turns.speaker: receptionist

turns.text: Hi there. I'm calling about your swimming courses for adults. I can swim a little, but not very well, and I'd really like to get better at it.
turns.speaker: caller

turns.text: Sure, we've got a few options for that. Before I go through them, can I take some details from you? That way I can put you on our list.
turns.speaker: receptionist

turns.text: Of course, go ahead.
turns.speaker: caller

turns.text: Great. What's your name, please?
turns.speaker: receptionist

turns.say: It's Lauren Whitaker. That's W, H, I, T, A, K, E, R.
turns.text: It's Lauren Whitaker. That's W-H-I-T-A-K-E-R.
turns.speaker: caller

turns.text: Got it, thanks, Lauren. And could I have your home address? We mail out a printed schedule every season.
turns.speaker: receptionist

turns.text: Sure. It's 42 Linden Avenue.
turns.speaker: caller

turns.say: Linden Avenue. Is that L, I, N, D, E, N?
turns.text: Linden Avenue. Is that L-I-N-D-E-N?
turns.speaker: receptionist

turns.text: That's right. It's the street that runs along the river.
turns.speaker: caller

turns.text: OK. We also ask for people's occupation, just for our records, because some employers have a discount arrangement with us.
turns.speaker: receptionist

turns.text: Oh, right. Well, I worked as a teacher for years, but then I retrained, so now I'm a nurse at Mercy Hospital.
turns.speaker: caller

turns.text: A nurse. Unfortunately, the hospital isn't one of our partners, but it might be worth asking your manager. Now, so I can recommend the right course, how far can you swim at the moment?
turns.speaker: receptionist

turns.text: Hmm. I'd love to say four lengths of the pool, but honestly, without stopping, it's more like two.
turns.speaker: caller

turns.text: That's fine, plenty of people are at that level. And is there anything in particular you'd like to work on?
turns.speaker: receptionist

turns.text: Well, my arms and legs are OK, I think. It's my breathing that's the real problem. I get out of breath really quickly, and then I panic a bit.
turns.speaker: caller

turns.text: That's really common, and our instructors are great with it. Oh, one last question for the form. How did you hear about us? Was it our website?
turns.speaker: receptionist

turns.text: No, actually, I saw a poster at the library. A friend had mentioned you too, but the poster had your phone number on it.
turns.speaker: caller

turns.say: Great. So, let me tell you about the courses. Our Beginners class is on Mondays at 6 p.m. It isn't in the main pool, it's in the teaching pool, which is smaller and not so deep. That one costs eighty-five dollars.
turns.text: Great. So, let me tell you about the courses. Our Beginners class is on Mondays at 6 p.m. It isn't in the main pool, it's in the teaching pool, which is smaller and not so deep. That one costs $85.
turns.speaker: receptionist

turns.text: I think I'm a bit past that level, though.
turns.speaker: caller

turns.text: I'd agree. The Improvers course would suit you better. That's on Wednesday evenings for ten weeks. It used to start at 7, but this season it's been moved to 7:30 because the swim team needs the pool earlier.
turns.speaker: receptionist

turns.text: Actually, 7:30 is better for me anyway, since I don't finish work until 6:30. How much is that one?
turns.speaker: caller

turns.say: It's one hundred ten dollars for the ten weeks.
turns.text: It's $110 for the ten weeks.
turns.speaker: receptionist

turns.text: OK. And is there anything after that? If I do well, I mean.
turns.speaker: caller

turns.say: Yes, there's Stroke Development. That's on Saturday mornings at 9, and you need to be able to swim 200 meters to join. Last year it was one hundred fifty dollars, but we've brought the price down to one hundred thirty-five dollars.
turns.text: Yes, there's Stroke Development. That's on Saturday mornings at 9, and you need to be able to swim 200 meters to join. Last year it was $150, but we've brought the price down to $135.
turns.speaker: receptionist

turns.text: That's not bad. What about private lessons? I've been thinking about having one or two just for my breathing.
turns.speaker: caller

turns.say: We do those too. They're forty-five dollars for half an hour. The only thing is, our instructors are pretty busy, so you have to book them a week in advance. You can't just call the day before.
turns.text: We do those too. They're $45 for half an hour. The only thing is, our instructors are pretty busy, so you have to book them a week in advance. You can't just call the day before.
turns.speaker: receptionist

turns.text: Good to know. And what do I need to bring to the classes?
turns.speaker: caller

turns.say: Well, a swimsuit, obviously, and we ask everyone to wear a swim cap. Goggles are a good idea too. You don't need to bring a towel, because you can rent one here for two dollars. But please bring a padlock for the lockers. We don't sell them at the front desk.
turns.text: Well, a swimsuit, obviously, and we ask everyone to wear a swim cap. Goggles are a good idea too. You don't need to bring a towel, because you can rent one here for $2. But please bring a padlock for the lockers. We don't sell them at the front desk.
turns.speaker: receptionist

turns.text: A padlock, OK. And how do I actually sign up?
turns.speaker: caller

turns.say: You can register online or in person. There's a one-time registration fee of twenty dollars, which covers any course you take with us. Then, when you come to your first class, please bring some photo ID, like a driver's license, so we can make your membership card.
turns.text: You can register online or in person. There's a one-time registration fee of $20, which covers any course you take with us. Then, when you come to your first class, please bring some photo ID, like a driver's license, so we can make your membership card.
turns.speaker: receptionist

turns.text: No problem. I think I'll go with the Improvers course, then.
turns.speaker: caller

turns.text: Great choice. I'll put you down for Wednesdays, and the schedule will be in the mail this week.
turns.speaker: receptionist

turns.text: Perfect. Thanks so much for your help, Greg.
turns.speaker: caller

turns.text: You're welcome, Lauren. See you in the pool!
turns.speaker: receptionist

questions.prompt: Improvers | Wednesdays at ______; ten weeks | $110
questions.evidence: It used to start at 7, but this season it's been moved to 7:30

questions.evidence: Last year it was $150, but we've brought the price down to $135.

explanation.en: $150 was last year's price. The course now costs $135.
explanation.ru: "$150" — это прошлогодняя цена. Сейчас курс стоит "$135".
explanation.uk: "$150" — це торішня ціна. Тепер курс коштує "$135".

questions.prompt: Private lessons | must be booked ______ in advance | $45 per half hour
questions.evidence: so you have to book them a week in advance

explanation.en: The instructors are busy, so private lessons must be booked a week ahead. Calling the day before is not possible.
explanation.ru: Инструкторы заняты, поэтому индивидуальные занятия нужно бронировать за неделю — "a week ahead". Позвонить накануне ("the day before") не получится.
explanation.uk: Інструктори зайняті, тому індивідуальні заняття треба бронювати за тиждень — "a week ahead". Зателефонувати напередодні ("the day before") не вийде.

questions.prompt: Equipment | bring a swim cap, goggles and a ______ | towel rental: $2
questions.evidence: But please bring a padlock for the lockers.

explanation.en: She does not need to bring a towel because she can rent one. She must bring a padlock for the lockers, as the center does not sell them.
explanation.ru: Полотенце ("towel") ей брать не нужно, его можно взять напрокат. А вот навесной замок для шкафчиков — "padlock" — она должна принести с собой, потому что в центре их не продают.
explanation.uk: Рушник ("towel") їй брати не потрібно, його можна взяти напрокат. А от навісний замок для шафок — "padlock" — вона має принести з собою, бо в центрі їх не продають.
